resolvedFindings.resolution: Replaced blocked-duration certificate-specific and recursion-specific actions with predicate-grounded inspection actions.

Replaced prose with typed negative facts that require comparison with the candidate predicate.
Split hard-negative matching into database network JVM Spring and web confusion groups.
Added bounded sanitized runtime context and verified 612 unique model inputs with zero cross-split overlap.

limitations: LEXICAL and HASH pair-review rows are deterministic predicate-consistency checks and are not represented as independent semantic reviewers.
The additional controlled families are development-only synthetic contexts rather than production incidents.
Candidate semantic and exact text overlap across splits is intentional; exact and normalized full model-input overlap is zero.
This review is not model evaluation or production qualification.
